task.question: What is the maximum sentence given to those convicted for the assassination of Marielle Franco in Brazil on 25 February 2026?
task.evidence: 25 February – The Supreme Federal Court convicts five people, including police chief Rivaldo Barbosa and politicians Chiquinho Brazão and his brother Domingos Brazão, for the 2018 assassination of Rio de Janeiro city councilor Marielle Franco and her driver and sentences them to up to 76 years' imprisonment.
task.sonnet_answer: 78 years (the maximum sentence handed down to those convicted, including Domingos Brazão and Chiquinho Brazão, at the trial concluded on 25 February 2025)

answer:
On 25 February 2026, Chiquinho and Domingos Brazão were convicted by the Supreme Court for ordering the assassination of Marielle Franco and Anderson Gomes, and they were both sentenced to 76 years in prison. 

FINAL: 76 years

messages.content: [Assassination of Marielle Franco] Marielle Franco, a Brazilian politician and activist, was fatally shot on 14 March 2018, in Estácio, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The assassins were in a car that pulled up alongside the Rio de Janeiro councilwoman's car and fired several shots, which also killed the driver, Anderson Gomes. Former military police officers Ronnie Lessa and Élcio Vieira de Queiroz confessed to the killings and, on 31 October 2024, were convicted by a jury and sentenced to 59 and 78 years in prison, respectively. On 24 March 2024, brothers Domingos Brazão and Chiquinho Brazão were arrested after being denounced as masterminds of the attack against Marielle Franco. Detective Rivaldo Barbosa was also arrested, suspected of obstructing the investigations and also intellectually orchestrating the crime.
